rationale: For an AI mock interview tool, users need deep focus and clarity. The dark high-contrast Swiss archetype provides a distraction-free, authoritative command-center feel, prioritizing text legibility and explicit hierarchy over decorative elements.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous paddings (p-6, p-8) for chat containers to allow breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and chat blocks. Center-align the main application container.
spacing_and_layout.container_classes: w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 h-screen flex flex-col

components.buttons: Flat, pure geometric styling. Primary button: bg-[#2563EB] text-white hover:bg-[#1D4ED8] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200. Secondary: border border-white/20 bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-white/5.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults stripped of generic roundness. rounded-sm, bg-[#121212] border border-white/20 focus:border-[#2563EB] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2563EB] text-white p-4.

chat_bubbles.ai: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-md p-6 left-aligned max-w-[85%]
chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#2563EB] text-white rounded-md p-6 right-aligned ml-auto max-w-[85%]

components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 py-4 px-6 flex justify-between items-center

interactions_and_motion.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a subtle drop shadow.
interactions_and_motion.chat_entrance: Message bubbles slide up and fade in staggeredly.

background_texture.usage: Use as a very low opacity (10-15%) fixed background cover to kill digital flatness.

ai_avatar.usage: Small circular avatar (w-8 h-8) next to the AI's chat messages.

AI_Mock_Interviewer: Header: App title 'MockAI' + User Role info.
Job Setup Section: Input field for Job Title + 'Start Interview' button (hidden once started).
Progress Indicator: Minimalist textual counter 'Question 1 of 6' with a thin progress bar.
Chat Display: Scrollable area. Flex column with gap-6. Empty state shows a welcoming message.
Input Area: Fixed at the bottom of the container. Textarea (auto-expanding) + 'Submit' button.
Feedback Panel: A conditionally rendered bento grid at the end of the interview summarizing strengths, critique, and tips.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over #0A0A0A is pure #FFFFFF. User chat text on #2563EB must be pure #FFFFFF.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: Apply data-testid to start-button, job-title-input, chat-input, submit-message-button, feedback-panel, chat-message-user, chat-message-ai.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the main page layout to maintain the 'Control Room Grid' strictness.
Use Shadcn components for complex logic (Textarea, ScrollArea, Button) but strictly override their styles to match the Archetype 4 dark high-contrast theme.
The UI must feel like a focused workspace. Do not use generic card shadows; use 1px solid borders.
Ensure the chat container auto-scrolls to the bottom when a new message is added.
Use the AI avatar image next to the interviewer's messages.
Mock the backend Claude integration if the actual API isn't wired yet, but ensure the frontend logic for dynamic follow-ups (6 questions) and final feedback generation is clear and functional.
Add yarn add @phosphor-icons/react for high-end technical icons.
